items.name: API Contracts
items.description: Consumer-driven contracts; contract testing in CI/CD; breaking changes require consumer notification

items.description: RESTful design; resource-oriented; HATEOAS for discoverability; consistent naming conventions

items.name: API Documentation

items.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details format; consistent error codes; no stack traces in production

items.name: API Security
items.description: OAuth 2.0 + OIDC; API keys for partners; rate limiting; input validation; no PII in URLs

items.description: URI versioning (v1, v2) for breaking changes; header versioning for minor; deprecation policy 12 months
